description_en: Modifies the name of an access control list (ACL)
description_zh: 调用ModifyACL修改访问控制名称
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-acl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-e30a66to95cs0000 --name newname --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyACL

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the ACL is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh:
访问控制实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the ACL is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The new name of the ACL.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.
parameters.description_zh:
访问控制实例的新名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
